name: Bánh canh chả cá Cù Lao Chàm
summary: Bánh canh chả cá on the island is the noodle soup filled with the local fish paste. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study names it as the change from the rice meal, and names bánh canh again in the afternoon list. It prints no broth and no stall price.
origin: Cham Islands. An afternoon bowl on Tân Hiệp, filled with the island fish paste.
howToEat: As the change of meal the 16 September 2025 study describes, in the afternoon, for visitors and islanders.
The study does not describe the noodles. A current price is Check on arrival. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
where: The Bai Lang coast road and the stalls by Giếng Xóm Cấm in Bai Ong, where the study places the afternoon food.
seoTitle: Bánh canh chả cá — fish-paste noodles, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Noodle soup filled with the island’s fish paste, named as afternoon food on the Bai Lang coast road. A stall price is Check on arrival.
